north_star: A person can desire, understand, and responsibly act on a layered geometric artifact without being asked to trust an opaque system.
product_thesis: Proof-led studio commerce: sell a named, explainable layer-stack experience first; accumulate reusable provenance and handoff infrastructure underneath it.
current_evidence: Three draft GCode fixtures with ordered distinct layers, matching SVG previews, manifest hashes, and static validation.
Quiet Bloom has a local browser Proof Rail that validates a served MachineJob against selected source data.
No physical material/profile/controller result, customer validation, checkout, ad result, or deployment evidence is present.

reconciliation_flags.observed_mismatch: The decision package names draft -> advisory -> release, while Family and MachineJob schemas allow draft | release | withdrawn.
reconciliation_flags.safe_current_behavior: Use draft plus the specific evidence state static_pass; physical_unrun.
reconciliation_flags.never: Add advisory to one UI, schema, or copy surface without a versioned compatibility decision.

non_negotiables: Keep Ritual Geometry as the owner of authored family identity, views, and display provenance; Omni-Loom is a future MachineJob consumer.
A model may propose intent; only a validated emitter may create a machine artifact.
Missing evidence is represented as unknown, draft, blocked, or physical_unrun; it is never polished into a pass.
No automatic system may commit, publish, spend, message, alter release state, or rewrite source truth without human authorization.
No public promise of universal cut-readiness, controller safety, material calibration, measured physics, or physical assembly before its evidence exists.

priority_formula.note: Scores are hypotheses used to sequence work, not validated market measurements.

work_orders.title: Reconcile the local Proof Rail increment and release vocabulary
work_orders.intention: Ensure the source of public work matches the verified local proof implementation and that release language has one deliberate compatibility rule before new work treats either as settled.
inputs: user authorization to commit and push
definition_of_done: only scoped changes are committed
fixture and contract tests pass
remote head equals expected commit
README and handoff state are accurate
advisory/withdrawn behavior is explicit across affected contracts

work_orders.title: Build the Field Kit offer and discovery page
work_orders.intention: Give one buyer a single clear reason to care, understand the layered object, inspect honest proof, and express bounded interest.
work_orders.audience: design-forward maker or art director with access to printing, a laser, a workshop, or a fabrication collaborator
definition_of_done: the visitor can describe the object and offer after one pass
all visible actions work locally
proof rail remains an inspection path
no payment/account/physical-result claim is implied
mobile and desktop browser checks pass
stop_rules: requires payment or analytics integration to demonstrate value
decorative motion hides the assembly explanation

work_orders.title: Complete structural proof coverage for all three fixture families
work_orders.intention: Make the renderer's proof behavior consistent and fail-closed across Quiet Bloom, Frequency Bloom, and Leaf Spiral.
definition_of_done: each family can show its own actual contract-to-source proof
mismatched IDs/hashes visibly withhold a positive result
all fixtures stay draft/physical_unrun
stop_rules: proof is represented by hard-coded UI

work_orders.title: Seed a local evidence-ledger knowledge graph
work_orders.intention: Make decisions, sources, claims, offers, tests, assets, and blockers queryable without granting an LLM authority over truth.
definition_of_done: at least 25 stable-ID records
every claim has a state and source pointer
audit reports unknown/stale/blocked relationships
no automatic mutation or network submission
stop_rules: graph is used as source authority
cloud/API credential is required for baseline function

work_orders.title: Produce the signature exploded-stack motion system
work_orders.intention: Teach layer contribution and registration through a premium, reusable motion language.
definition_of_done: each layer receives a distinct visual beat
final assembly is readable without sound
motion never implies unobserved physical behavior
performance and reduced-motion checks pass
stop_rules: motion becomes a generic shader demo
visual accuracy requires unvalidated material behavior

work_orders.title: Prepare paid-discovery and partner outreach kit
work_orders.intention: Turn interest into learning with bounded creative variants, an interview guide, and a spending/claim boundary.
definition_of_done: every creative tests one stated hypothesis
all links resolve to one destination
metrics distinguish click from qualified interest
nothing is published or spent automatically

work_orders.title: Run the first physical evidence bench
work_orders.intention: Convert one draft family from simulated structural proof toward observed material-specific evidence.
definition_of_done: records name the machine/material/profile/date/operator
measurements and exceptions are preserved
result remains draft/advisory unless release gate is genuinely met
stop_rules: attempt to infer result from browser preview

candidate_agent_skills.purpose: Check a Family, MachineJob, manifest, source hash, evidence state, and public copy for unsupported promotion.
candidate_agent_skills.output: pass/fail/unknown report with exact source pointers
candidate_agent_skills.never: silently repair a mismatch or promote physical status

candidate_agent_skills.purpose: Convert an approved offer hypothesis into a landing-page brief, creative matrix, event schema, and stop criteria.
candidate_agent_skills.input: one named audience, offer, and boundary
candidate_agent_skills.never: publish ads, spend, message prospects, or invent conversion evidence

candidate_agent_skills.purpose: Normalize project records and surface stale/unknown/blocked links as candidate insights.
candidate_agent_skills.never: treat an inferred relationship as source truth or mutate records automatically

candidate_agent_skills.purpose: Turn layer metadata into a motion storyboard with accessibility and evidence constraints.
candidate_agent_skills.input: layer order, visual roles, intended audience, visual source
candidate_agent_skills.output: shot list, timing spec, static fallback, implementation test plan
candidate_agent_skills.never: use motion to imply vibration, physical simulation, or fabrication proof

candidate_agent_skills.purpose: Validate a backend adapter's declared transformations and reject undocumented unit/path/machine changes.
candidate_agent_skills.never: emit release artifacts without material, machine, and evidence gates
